mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past three months compresses discount rates for equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as monetary policy eases.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods where FEDFUNDS has declined for three consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in unemployment rate exceeding 0.5 percentage points over three months signals deteriorating labor market conditions, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to reduced consumer spending.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE has risen by more than 0.5pp over three months.

mechanism_narrative: When inflation (CPIAUCSL) exceeds 3.5% year-over-year and the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 4.0%, persistent inflation concerns trigger equity sell-offs, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL YoY change > 3.5% and FEDFUNDS > 4.0.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansion regimes characterized by strong housing starts, S&P 500 valuations become stretched, leading to negative forward returns over the next 60 trading days as economic momentum peaks.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods classified as late-cycle expansion (HOUST > 1300 and GDPC1 growth > 2.5% YoY).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payroll employment over the past three months supports consumer spending and corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods where PAYEMS has increased for three consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts below 1250 thousand units signals weakening consumer demand, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as housing sector contraction spreads to broader economy.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where HOUST falls below 1250 thousand units.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) below 1300 thousand units and industrial production (INDPRO) below 100 signal dual demand-supply contraction, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where HOUST < 1300 and INDPRO < 100.

mechanism_narrative: In manufacturing slowdown regimes where industrial production (INDPRO) is below 100, reduced corporate capital expenditure and economic growth trigger negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods where INDPRO < 100.
